system.description:
Effect

Can be attached to your belt or bag to be used without being held in your hand.

Effect

Upon landing a critical hit with this weapon, apply Bleeding to the target.

Effect

You gain a +1 Armorbreaker Power bonus against targets in Heavy armor or higher.

Effect

The first spell you cast each turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Effect

You may make melee attacks with this weapon that deal Physical(Piercing) damage without provoking attacks of opportunity.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

The guard of this armor is reduced by 1, but unarmored allies (except armor plates) within 40ft of you gain +1 guard.

Effect

Wild Swing now ignores guard, but the damage is reduced to 2 (light attack) or 4 (heavy attack).

Effect

When making a light attack at a target you can move 10ft in a straight line towards them.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

The Grappling Hook Artifice is modified to be mounted onto the belt, allowing for operation while wielding items in both hands via a switch mounted on the arm.

Effect

Grants a +1/+1 Bonus, doesn’t stack with material bonuses. Weapon shatters, becoming irreparably broken on a 1 roll for an accuracy roll.

Effect

This armor reduces your RP by 2, but does not reduce your evasion and dodge.

Effect

This armor reduces your RP by 3, but does not reduce your evasion and dodge.

Effect

The light attack is made against all enemies within 10ft of the target instead of 5ft.

Effect

When you fire a pie through the launcher, you may deal 1 sure hit full pierce damage to all other targets within 5ft of the target.

Effect

When dealing damage with a Heavy attack, you may choose to not do damage to instead reduce a creature’s movement speed to 0 until the start of your next turn or until you move. Does not work against bosses or creatures bigger than you.

Effect

All attacks with this weapon gain the Prone keyword. While prone, you are considered to have low cover against ranged attacks.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

When dealing damage with this weapon, you may take true damage equal to the damage dice (ie 6 on a d6) to maximize the damage of one die.

Effect

Once per turn, attacks from this weapon cause the target to only be able to make heavy attacks of opportunity against you until the end of your turn.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

After making a Heavy unarmed attack with the limb, you may spend 0 RP to make a Light attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide, 15ft long cone behind the target. After doing this, you must put in a new shell into the limb to use it again (your movement speed is halved if your leg is unusable).

Effect

First basic heavy attack per turn dazes targets on damage.

Effect

Grants Hollow Blow: When attacking and hitting a target, you deal additional damage if they Block. This damage is 2 on a Light/Precise attack or 4 on a Heavy attack.

Effect

After using a throwing attack with this weapon, you can return the weapon to your hand for 0 RP.

Effect

Deals +1 damage against light armor or unarmored targets.

Effect

While wearing this item, you gain a +4 Shield bonus to your block. This stacks with Still Stone Style's Shielding Fist, but not with other shields.

Effect

Your first light attack each turn with this weapon gains Trick Attack, but it can no longer make Heavy attacks.

Effect

Pick a color theme. You gain +5 to stealth when hiding in environments of that theme, but -5 when hiding elsewhere. A GM may approve new environments, defaults are: green camo (jungle, woodland, prone in grass), yellow camo (desert, savannas), white camo (snow, arctic), dark camo (night, caves, rocky terrain), blue camo (rivers or oceanic)

Effect

When dealing damage to a Grunt with a Heavy attack, they are stunned until the start of your next turn even if they are still above 0 HP.

Effect

When using the Longsword with one hand, once per turn you can extend the range of your attack by 5ft.

Effect

You may cancel the effect of this artifice for 0 RP. When you do, if you were attached to a ceiling or vertical surface, treat the fall as if it was 100ft lower than it is.

Effect

Cannot be defended against by 0 RP actions. Attacks made with this weapon do not count as consuming 0 RP actions.

Effect

Increases the block gained from this armor by 4.

Effect

Your ranged mode also counts as a channeling weapon for the purpose of casting spells through it, as if the weapon it is attached to was a channeling weapon.

Effect

Your movement speed is increased by 5ft.

Effect

When your other hand is free and you take a movement action that costs RP, that movement range is increased by 5ft.

Effect

The first basic attack per turn made immediately after moving 50ft or more, dismounts mounted targets on damage.

Effect

When the target takes damage, the flame flickers a different color.

Effect

Instead of Nightvision, these goggles give you Darkvision.

Effect

When looking at a magic effect, you may attempt to understand it as if using Decipher Magic. Your bonus for this roll is +15, regardless of your reason or magic skill points.

Effect

The first time you are attacked while stealthed while this device is active, you automatically dodge the attack.

Effect

Gain +1 bonus to accuracy rolls, but can only fire elemental attacks of 1 element. Spells cast through this wand only gain that bonus if they deal that element of damage.

Effect

An accuracy roll against you that rolls a 1 always misses.

Effect

Can be used while dismounted as a normal spear, but loses its movement max damage bonus unless mounted.

Effect

Shearing now always deals +1 damage regardless of armor.

Effect

The lamp contains a flame that points in the direction of the person the lamp is attuned to.

Effect

Makes the light directionally forward instead of all around.

Effect

While within the device's range, you can determine the direction the paired device is in.

Effect

Accuracy is reduced by 3, but attacks with this weapon reduce the target’s ranged accuracy by 1 (stacking) until the start of your next turn regardless of if they hit or not. Doesn’t affect boss enemies.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

The first heavy attack you make with this weapon per turn also light attacks the same target afterwards.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

The first basic attack you make with this weapon in a turn inflicts burning 5 regardless of it hits or not. (If used with Open Choke mod, this can affect that attack).
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

The first attack you make with this weapon in a turn inflicts burning 5 regardless of it hits or not.

Effect

The Grappling Hook Artifice loses the ability to move allies, but you can now make attacks at any point while being reeled as long as you have actions. While you are moving in this way, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Effect

You may spend 0 RP to deactivate the effect.

Effect

When you make a basic Heavy attack, you may split the damage against two different targets in range. Make only 1 accuracy check against both.

Effect

The first basic attack you make each turn may trigger the knockback effect without spending mana.
